posts.heading: September 14, 2026
posts.text:
Twenty-one feeder visits occurred after the 10:30 mark. Tufted Titmice appear sporadically. Blue Jays are present on the ground near the nectar source. Northern Cardinals and Carolina Chickadees provide the primary background sound.

A Carolina Chickadee is visiting the feeders. A Tufted Titmouse is perched on the tube seed feeder. The Red-shouldered Hawk was last heard in the 11:00 hour.

Twenty-eight and a half degrees Celsius holds steady under clear skies.

The day’s total is 217 visits. Tufted Titmice and Carolina Chickadees account for the majority of sightings.
